description: Spec authoring task: write a spec for a new feature. Adapter must surface the Gherkin-missing-scenarios record.
task_text: Write a spec for the new feature. Plain requirement bullets are not enough: every requirement must be backed by a Given/When/Then scenario so sdd-verify has executable acceptance criteria.
expected_applied_rules: Spec file shipped with plain requirement bullets but no Given/When/Then scenarios, leaving the sdd-verify and downstream agents without executable acceptance criteria.
